title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.28561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is the cornerstone of modern deep learning, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain poorly understood in non-convex settings. To address this gap, we study SGD dynamics in deep linear neural networks - simplified models that retain key non-convex characteristics while remaining analytically tractable. Building on recent results for gradient descent, we extend convergence guarantees to SGD under regularized squared loss. We establish almost sure boundedness of SGD iterates. Using the framework of asymptotic pseudotrajectories from stochastic approximation theory, our analysis establishes then, for both deterministic and adaptive step-size choices, convergence of SGD to the set of critical points under mild conditions (without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data). translated_title: 学习线性神经网络的随机梯度下降收敛性
translated_abstract: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是现代深度学习的基石，但其在非凸设置下的理论收敛性质仍然知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们研究了深度线性神经网络中的SGD动力学——这是一种保留了关键非凸特性同时在分析上仍可处理的简化模型。基于最近关于梯度下降的结果，我们将收敛保证扩展到了正则化平方损失下的SGD。我们建立了SGD迭代序列的几乎必然有界性。利用随机逼近理论中的渐近伪轨迹框架，我们的分析进一步在温和条件下（不依赖于Lipschitz性质或白化数据），针对确定性和自适应两种步长选择，建立了SGD收敛到临界点集合的结果。据我们所知，这是首个为深度线性网络中的SGD提供几乎必然收敛保证的工作。
tldr: 本文首次为深度线性神经网络中的随机梯度下降提供了几乎必然收敛保证，证明在温和条件下（无需Lipschitz性质或白化数据）SGD可收敛到临界点集合。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first almost sure convergence guarantees for SGD in deep linear neural networks, establishing convergence to the set of critical points under mild conditions without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data.
